skill.name: summary-generator
skill.description: Generate concise lesson summaries from educational Markdown files using a structured Socratic extraction process.
skill.summary: Creates companion lesson summaries with core concepts, mental models, patterns, mistakes, and learning connections.

content.value_statement: Long lessons are hard to review when learners need fast recall. This skill creates concise Markdown summaries with concepts, patterns, mistakes, and learning connections.
actual_capabilities: Reads a target lesson Markdown file before summarizing.
Extracts the proficiency level from lesson frontmatter when present.
Uses six Socratic questions to identify essential lesson content.
Produces sections for concepts, mental models, patterns, mistakes, and connections.
Applies word count guidelines based on lesson complexity.
Names companion files with the .summary.md convention.
limitations: Requires access to the lesson content before it can produce a useful summary.
Designed for educational Markdown lessons, not general business documents.
Does not independently verify facts beyond the source lesson.
May need human review for lessons with unclear prerequisites or outcomes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Student Review Notes
use_cases.description: Create short companion summaries so learners can revisit core ideas without rereading a full lesson.

use_cases.title: Refresh Existing Course Content
use_cases.description: Regenerate summaries after lessons change, while keeping a consistent structure across the course.

use_cases.title: Support Practice Sessions
use_cases.description: Give learners quick references for key patterns, common mistakes, and connected topics during exercises.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Lesson
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single lesson file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the summary-generator skill on this lesson file. Create the companion summary with the standard sections and length guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Draft Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this lesson with its current summary. Refresh weak sections, remove full explanations, and keep only essential review content.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Summarize A Module
prompt_templates.scenario: Create consistent summaries for related lessons.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the summary-generator process to each lesson in this module. Preserve each lesson's level, concepts, patterns, mistakes, and connections.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Summary Quality
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced quality check for course documentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these lesson summaries against the skill checklist. Identify missing mental models, weak practice patterns, and unclear prerequisite links.

output_examples.input: A beginner lesson introduces Python data types and common type errors.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a short summary with the core concept, type mental models, practical patterns, common mistakes, and next learning links.

output_examples.input: An intermediate lesson explains debugging workflows for AI-assisted coding.
output_examples.output: The skill extracts workflow patterns, AI collaboration keys, frequent debugging mistakes, and links to prerequisite testing knowledge.

output_examples.input: A course author asks to refresh an outdated lesson summary.
output_examples.output: The skill compares the lesson against the summary, removes extra explanation, and updates the companion file structure.

best_practices: Read the full lesson before generating the summary.
Keep each section focused on recall, not full instruction.
Check the final word count against the lesson proficiency level.
anti_patterns: Do not include full lesson explanations in the summary.
Do not add practice exercises or motivational text.
Do not expose internal course framework labels to learners.

faq.question: What files does this skill summarize?
faq.answer: It is designed for educational lesson files written in Markdown.

faq.question: Does it create a new file?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow names a companion summary file with the .summary.md suffix.

faq.question: Does it run external commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a Markdown instruction file and does not define shell commands.

faq.question: Can it summarize advanced lessons?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides longer word count guidance for advanced lessons with more connections.

faq.question: Can it replace human editing?
faq.answer: No. Authors should review summaries for accuracy, tone, and course alignment.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
